title: Managed Backup: amendment allowance
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines amendment allowance.

## Tier basis

**Monthly accepted amendment limit.** Maximum accepted capacity amendments per holding in a UTC calendar month; integer.

| Contract tier | Monthly accepted amendment limit |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | 12 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | 12 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | 12 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | 12 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | 12 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | 12 |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, monthly accepted amendment limit is 12.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, monthly accepted amendment limit stays the same.
